description: Barons Court: Closed - This station is closed due to planned engineering works.

BARONS COURT STATION: From Monday 6 July until November, westbound trains will not call at Barons Court. If travelling westbound from the station, please use eastbound District or Piccadilly line trains and change to westbound services at West Kensington (on the District line) or Earls Court (on the Piccadilly line) and change to westbound services. If travelling westbound to the station, please continue to Hammersmith and change for eastbound District or Piccadilly line trains.

HOLLOWAY ROAD STATION: Saturday 19 September, between 1615 and 1730, eastbound trains do not stop at the station due to a football match at Emirates Stadium. The station will operate as exit only at these times.
Oxford Circus Station: reduced escalator service - there is no up escalator in service from the Central line due to a fault.

WATERLOO STATION: Although step-free access is available to/from the Bakerloo line southbound platform, the curved platform has large gaps between train and platform, has no manual boarding ramps, and is unsuitable for wheelchair users and those with pushchairs.

WEAVER LINE: Saturday 19 and Sunday 20 September, no service between Hackney Downs and Cheshunt / Enfield Town. Use London Underground connections between Central London and Seven Sisters, and Clapton for Rectory Road. Replacement buses operate. The limited number of GREATER ANGLIA and STANSTED EXPRESS trains which usually serve Seven Sisters stop at Tottenham Hale instead.
additionalInformation: Replacement buses operate:Service L1: Seven Sisters - Bruce Grove - White Hart Lane (subject to change after Tottenham match on Saturday) - Silver Street - Edmonton Green - Bush Hill Park (Great Cambridge Road) - Enfield Town;Service L2: Seven Sisters - Bruce Grove - White Hart Lane (subject to change after Tottenham match on Saturday) - Silver Street - Edmonton Green - Bush Hill Park (Great Cambridge Road) -Southbury - Turkey Street (Hertford Road) - Theobalds Grove - Cheshunt;

description: HOLLOWAY ROAD STATION: Saturday 19 September, between 1910 and 2040, the station will be closed due to a football match at Emirates Stadium.

WEMBLEY PARK STATION: Saturday 19 September, between 2000 and 2110, the station will be busy due to an American Football match at Wembley Stadium. The Bridge Road entrance will be exit only until the queue to enter the station clears. Entry to the station, including step-free access via lift, will be via Olympic Way. Please allow extra time for your journey

Farringdon: No Step Free Access - Step free access is not available between the westbound platform at Barbican and the Elizabeth line at Farringdon due to planned maintenance. Call 0343 222 1234 if you need help planning your journey.

BUCKHURST HILL STATION: From Monday 10 August until Autumn 2026, the footbridge is closed due to maintenance work. Please use the subway from eastbound platform 2 to access westbound platform 1. Step-free access remains available to both platforms via the ramps.

WEMBLEY PARK STATION: From Monday 10 March until Autumn 2026, no lift service between the street (Wembley Way / car park) and ticket hall. Step-free access is still available by using the entrance/exit on Bridge Road which is level between street and ticket hall. Lifts remain available to all platforms.

Barons Court Station: Westbound trains are not stopping due to a customer incident.
Stratford Station: Closed - This station is closed due to a casualty on the track.
Holloway Road Station: This station has reopened following an earlier customer incident.
WATERLOO STATION: In an emergency evacuation, follow the instructions of station staff and the police.
